newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico to get $6 bln in IADB loans - report.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to get $6 bln in IADB loans - report.

text.p: Mexico will receive $6.0 billion in loans from the Interamerican Development Bank (IADB) over the next three years, the newspaper Excelsior quoted Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo as saying.
The newspaper said Zedillo made his comments in Santiago, Chile, where he is attending a summit of Spanish-speaking presidents and where he met the president of the IADB.
The money will be used for various development projects, the newspaper.
